question: Can the installed native HUD assets be extracted offline and the health, psi and suit display objects identified?
claim: Base and patched native HUD movie/UI definition extracted with valid sizes and CRCs. Patched ActionScript references and named display-list placements agree on _root.safe.quadrant_SW.health_mc, psi_mc and armor_mc. Their parent also contains unrelated gameplay indicators and must not be moved wholesale.
method: Python 3.12 read-only archive parser derived from Steam Ghidra bodies, EGS symbols as leads, Twofish 0.3.0 C extension and PyCryptodome. JPEXS 26.3.0 exports mapped with tools/re/map_native_hud.py. Reproduction commands in docs/NATIVE-WRIST-HUD-2026-09-27.md. Nine synthetic tests include known-answer encryption and corruption controls.

identity.reason: Exact supported DLL SHA256 checked; archive and asset hashes recorded.

instrument.reason: Twofish known-answer vector, OAEP padding, complete directory bounds/counts, file size/CRC and decoded script/placement agreement.

control.reason: Nine synthetic tests including wrong DLL, bad CRC, corrupt OAEP, truncation and malformed XML.

scene.reason: No game scene required for offline asset hierarchy.

restore.reason: Original game files opened read-only; only local extracted copies and tools written.

baseline.reason: Static/offline user scope. No game or headset run.

limits: Asset paths and authored hierarchy only; no current display-object pointers, live transforms, render isolation or native wrist submission proved. Archive signature is not authenticated. Assets and decompiler output are local under ignored build/native-hud; regenerate using recorded source hashes. Integration worktree graph/fleet intake awaits canonical-root availability.

artifacts.role: Named display-list placements and script references
Steam native function body identities and root vtable slots

do_not_repeat.approach: Treat standard ZIP-reader failure as an asset-extraction blocker
do_not_repeat.reason: The installed archives use RSA-wrapped key tables and Twofish CTR; the bounded offline decoder succeeds.
do_not_repeat.reopen_when: A different DLL or archive format fails the recorded identity/format checks.

next_action: Use verified paths to prove value lifetime and temporary display-state changes inside native Flash render locks, preserve masks/filters/order, capture a fresh status-only texture and connect the existing wrist consumer. Preserve normal HUD on failure; validate in game only when user runtime scope permits.
